title: The model doesn't change. What changes is <1>where we place control</1> and what we optimise.
lead: Performance is always the result of a coordinated system.

items.name: Manufacturers
items.matters: Warranty cost over sales · in-field product quality · First Time Fix · Turnaround Time · service network control · direct impact on P&L.
items.apply: Service is managed as a financial and quality control lever. Technical validation, real-time in-field failure data and continuous product improvement.
items.achieve: Reduced warranty cost, measurable quality improvement and turning failure into useful information for the product.
items.closing: Service stops being a cost. It becomes a business control system.

items.name: Retail
items.matters: In-store customer experience · resolution speed · operational visibility · incident reduction · coordination across multiple providers.
items.apply: Service is integrated as part of the buying experience: we prioritise the front office, speed up assignment and pickups, coordinate the service network and logistics, and provide continuous visibility.
items.achieve: Better customer experience, less operational load in store, faster resolution and daily control of the service.
items.closing: Service stops being friction and becomes part of the experience.

items.name: Insurance
items.matters: Claim cost control · process efficiency · resolution times · scalability · policyholder satisfaction.
items.apply: Service is managed as a financial control process. We structure case validation, automate decisions where applicable and monitor financial and operational KPIs.
items.achieve: Lower claim costs, greater process control, better resolution times and operational scalability.
items.clients: Assurant · AIG · Caser · Companjon · Pelayo · Plus Ultra · Seyna
items.closing: Service becomes a financial control tool.

items.name: Electronics & distribution
items.matters: Service cost · speed · returns reduction · operational efficiency.
items.apply: We optimise the system for efficiency and cost. We fine-tune network assignment, optimise spare parts and supply chain, reduce unnecessary interventions and improve diagnosis.
items.achieve: Lower cost per intervention, fewer returns and higher operational efficiency.
items.clients: ElectroDepot · PC Componentes · Jocel · Telefac · Neumesse · Acadesa
items.closing: Service becomes a direct efficiency lever.

items.name: Mobility
items.matters: Network capillarity · response speed · user experience · safety.
items.apply: Service adapts to a distributed environment: we deploy capillary service networks, prioritise response times, simplify diagnosis and coordinate field interventions.
items.achieve: Greater coverage, shorter response times and a consistent experience regardless of territory.
items.clients: Navee · Nilox · Denver · Ducati · Aprilia · Jeep · Lamborghini · Red Bull
items.closing: Service happens where the customer is.

items.name: Utilities
items.matters: Continuous availability · SLA compliance · service continuity · loyalty.
items.apply: Service is managed as critical infrastructure. We guarantee constant availability, prioritise immediate assignment, control SLAs in real time and ensure continuous communication.
items.achieve: SLA compliance, greater service continuity and a better end-customer experience.
items.clients: Programmes operated with leading companies in the sector

synthesis: One system. Different priorities. <1>One single result: control and performance.</1>
